title.narrative: Informationsmøder og videoproduktion vedr CKU-projekter i Arusha og Iringa, Tanzania

description.narrative: This activity firstly will bring the project manager from the Iringa project on a 18-day visit to Denmark in August of 2025. During that time she will visit primary and secondary schools, boarding schools and congregations from within and outside of Danish Lutheran Mission. She will inform and explain on the project and give insight on the living conditions of nomadic pastoralist women in Tanzania, and what the CKU-funded project aims to accomplice with its activitites. During the visits and information meetings the project manager will be accompanied by a DLM missionary also involved in the daily implementation of the project. Secondly, the activity will hire an external consultant to produce quality media material from the MHM-project in Arusha Region to be used in information work in Denmark. The information activities are expected to increase knowledge and understanding of the society in Tanzania in general and the life of women and youth in the two regions in particular.
